The '''Obsta Desert''' was a desert that surrounded the capital city of [[Thousand Thousand]] on [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]].<ref name="GatORW" />

South of the city was a mining district that included [[Mining Machine No. 9]].<ref name="GatORW" />
